choreography: provider-a and provider-b use their synthetic CTE sessions for directory operations
an ACE Connect Lite instance points its configured vrscheck host/port at the local Baudot compatibility adapter
ACE issues GET /vrsverify/?vrsnum=<number> for VRS-number classification
the adapter translates the CTE routability result into only the message and data[0].vrs fields observed in the public ACE consumer
AllCallQuery remains the separate source of the logical route; no claim is made that ACE consumes that URI from /vrsverify/
a synthetic NPAC observation makes provider-b eligible to gain a provider-a TN
provider-b provisions the TN and the query replica changes after the configured delay
provider-a is denied further writes after the first accepted gaining-provider provision
claimBoundary: ACE Connect Lite is an implementation under test, not normative iTRS truth.
The observed /vrsverify/ behavior is a classification consumer seam, not evidence that ACE consumes an iTRS logical SIP URI from that response.
The compatibility facade does not reconstruct the original verifier service or a production provider / Numbering Administrator interface.
